For a fixed \(y\) (with \(-3\le y\le 3\))

\[

Now integrate this area over all admissible \(y\):

   =2\Bigl[(27-9)-(-27+9)\Bigr]   \\
  &=2\cdot36 = 72 .
\end{aligned}
\]
